description: Add SQS-to-S3 message delivery infrastructure: an S3 bucket, a Lambda function triggered by SQS that persists messages to S3, and all necessary IAM permissions and cdk-nag compliance.
steps: In lib/example-project-stack.ts, add imports for aws-s3, aws-lambda, aws-lambda-event-sources, aws-iam, and aws-logs modules using namespace import style (import * as s3 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3').

Create an S3 bucket (construct ID 'ExampleProjectMessageBucket') with: encryptionKey set to the existing 'key' variable, blockPublicAccess: s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL, enforceSSL: true, removalPolicy: cdk.RemovalPolicy.RETAIN, versioned: true.

Create a Lambda function (construct ID 'SqsToS3Function') with: runtime Node.js 22.x, handler 'index.handler', inline code that reads SQS event records and writes each message body to S3 with a key based on timestamp/messageId, timeout 30 seconds, environment variables for the bucket name.
Add an SQS event source to the Lambda using aws-lambda-event-sources.SqsEventSource targeting ExampleProjectQueue1 (or a new dedicated queue if preferred).
Grant the Lambda function permissions: bucket.grantWrite(fn), queue.grantConsumeMessages(fn), key.grantEncryptDecrypt(fn).

Handle cdk-nag compliance: The Lambda will need a log group with retention (use aws-logs.LogGroup with retention policy). Acknowledge any unavoidable cdk-nag findings with meaningful reasons. S3 bucket may need server access logging acknowledged or configured.

Add unit tests in test/example-project.test.ts that verify: (1) S3 bucket is created with encryption, (2) Lambda function is created, (3) Lambda has SQS event source mapping, (4) Lambda has correct environment variables pointing to the bucket.
Run npm run format, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test, and npm run cdk-nag to verify all CI checks pass.
acceptance_criteria: An S3 bucket resource exists in the synthesized template with KMS encryption using ExampleProjectKey
A Lambda function exists that is triggered by an SQS queue event source
The Lambda function has write access to the S3 bucket and decrypt/encrypt access to the KMS key
npm run typecheck passes with no errors
npm run lint passes with no errors
npm test passes with all tests green
npm run cdk-nag passes with no unacknowledged errors
